text.tspan: Bookx begins with an onboarding page, prompting user to add a folder,
which will then take it to library view (even if folder is empty)

tspan.tspan: Select a folder to add books to the library

text.tspan: User can open a book, not present in Library folder to read,
or Add Book which would copy it to Library folder.
The above box/carousel should encourage user to start reading a book. Maybe display book which was
most read last week, or recently added.
Otherwise it should show the last reading book, upon clicking, should open that book in reading mode
A single click should not open the book mode but make it into focus, enabling multiple books to be
selected with Shift, allowing user to delete or transfer them all at once.
Double click should open the book.
Properties leaflet should allow editable metadata to be changed.
Exporting Annotations should open the GTK dialog for the intended
location to save and file name.
If Annotations are exported for a group of books, then select folder option
should be provided, annotations will be exported in selected format, with
the original book name as file name.
1.c When something goes wrong / Empty state
This could be due to empty library folder, parsing issues, or
Allow user to undo the deletion of Book.

flowRoot.flowPara: The book "abcdefghijklm" along with it's Bookmarks and Annotations will be deleted.
$N books with their Bookmarks and Annotations will be deleted.

text.tspan: If User is sending book via app first time, We'll ask to select a Device and then propose the "Send to
User can also select the device later on, which device to send.
Multiple selection mode is enabled via shift sinlgle click or using Shift in combination with arrow keys.
This mode should allow the operations doable via the context menu to be done on all books, say
sending books, deleting them in group.
The mode is reverted by pressing single on any empty space.
